summary: Obfuscated offensive mass-mailing / SMTP-credential-cracking CLI toolkit
details: Package is a heavily obfuscated operator-run offensive-security framework distributed as an npm CLI (advertised as a 'light-speed mailing server'). Module layout covers mailbox intrusion (imap/pop3/ews/owa), SMTP relay abuse and credential checking against SendGrid and AWS SES (func/smx/{awschk,awssho,awsxt,sgapi,sgsho,sgxt,sendgrid,passgo,vaws}), Shodan-driven SMTP hunting, proxy rotation, bulk mailer modules (func/snd/mlr/*), and mailbox brute/verification helpers (func/box/{imap,pop3,ewsv,msap}). All 400+ JS files are RC4-string-array obfuscated. package.json declares no install/preinstall/postinstall lifecycle scripts; main is a self-executing CLI intended for explicit invocation by the operator against operator-chosen external targets. On CLI startup the entrypoint loads utils/lgrd and calls verifyGuardSeal(<32-byte hex seal>) + installLicenseGuard(), which is a commercial license/integrity phone-home to the vendor domain (package.json.homepage https://mntmc.rip). No code paths were observed that read installer-side secrets such as ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profile stores, or environment credentials, and no persistence or backdoor into the installer host was observed; the offensive capability is directed at operator-supplied external mail infrastructure, not at the machine that installed the package.
